command: docker compose up --wait --wait-timeout 60; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker compose ps; docker compose exec -T backend id; docker compose exec -T frontend id; (Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:3000/health) | ConvertTo-Json; (Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:3000/ready) | ConvertTo-Json; $metricResponse = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000/metrics; Write-Output ("Metrics HTTP " + $metricResponse.StatusCode); Write-Output (($metricResponse.Content -split "`n" | Select-String "http_requests_total" | Select-Object -First 5) -join "`n"); Get-ChildItem packages | Select-Object Name,Length
